descriptionChirho: A feminine noun denoting a catastrophic overthrow or total destruction, used exclusively in the comparative construction 'like the overthrow of' to evoke the paradigmatic divine judgment on Sodom and Gomorrah. Found in Isaiah, Jeremiah, Amos, and Deuteronomy. Both clusters share identical prepositional framing (eng: like the overthrow of, spa: como destrucción de, hin: जैसे उलटावा, arb: كَانْقِلَابِ, kor: 뒤집힘 같이, swa: kama kupinduliwa kwa / kama mapinduzi ya) and differ only in minor contextual variation, not semantic content.
